# function: backup_restore_testing_plan

Builds the ARN of an `backup` `restoreTestingPlan`:

```
arn:${Partition}:backup:${Region}:${Account}:restore-testing-plan:${RestoreTestingPlanName}-${RestoreTestingPlanId}
```

`${Partition}`, `${Region}` and `${Account}` come from the configuration file (`.arn.hcl`, or the path in `ARN_CONFIG`). The remaining placeholders are the arguments, in template order.



## Signature

<!-- signature generated by tfplugindocs -->
```text
backup_restore_testing_plan(restore_testing_plan_name string, restore_testing_plan_id string, options map of string...) string
```

## Arguments

<!-- arguments generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `restore_testing_plan_name` (String) Value for `${RestoreTestingPlanName}` in the ARN template.
1. `restore_testing_plan_id` (String) Value for `${RestoreTestingPlanId}` in the ARN template.
<!-- variadic argument generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `options` (Variadic, Map of String) Optional overrides: `account` (the name of an `account` block in the configuration file), `account_id` (a literal account id), `region` and `partition`. At most one options map may be given.
